english.note: Use this especially for gaining an abstract thing such as support, permission, or an opportunity.

exampleSentences.english: I finally obtain my boss's support.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我終於得到老闆嘅支持。

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose equivalent for obtaining something or gaining a result, benefit, or possession.

exampleSentences.english: I finally managed to acquire a bonus.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 dak1 dou3 fan6 zoeng2 gam1 laa3
